opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation. Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of the Society requiring additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential. Established in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft. Funds may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries, but not staff salaries.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research. Applications closed for 2026; will reopen in 2027.

opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society members (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Supports member engagement at Society meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers conference registration, meeting dinners, and a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation up to the total value of the award.
